messages:
kai: quick heads-up — console lint surfaced a bunch of tenants with ambiguous heartbeat headers, looks like routing is falling through to v2 for traffic we expect to keep on v1 :thinking:
ian: ugh, any logs or repro?
kai: yup. sample request headers we saw from the proxy chain:
```
GET /generate
Host: api.redwood.local
x-client-version: 1
x-client-ping: 16777216
# but the edge sometimes rewrites to x-version: auto
```
ian: so proxies are stripping x-client-version and adding x-version=auto? that would trigger our precedence rules and push to v2 routing, right?
maria: and the billing side treats that as v2 usage — quotas and token counts are being attributed to the wrong model pool. Saw ~3% token shift in the last 6h on a sample tenant.
sarah: do we have a telemetry tag to distinguish the original handshake vs proxy-injected? current metric only has route_version and client_declared_version (often empty).
kai: not reliably. proposal: add a "handshake_source" tag with values: client, upsteam-proxy, null — helps alerting and dashboarding.
devex-bot: new lint rule suggestion: warn when both x-client-version and x-version are present or when x-client-version is missing but older SDKs are expected.
ian: short-term mitigation: change header precedence on the router so explicit x-client-version wins if present (even if downstream proxy adds x-version). easy patch: set precedence order: x-client-version -> x-version -> default.
ops-bot: alert: heartbeat-mismatch spike detected: 1,208 tenants flagged in last 15m (severity: medium).
maria: we'll also need quota-accounting fix so we don't retroactively bill v2 for traffic that had v1 declared — at least prevent double-attribution until we patch routing.
sarah: UX ask: console needs a visible badge and breakdown for "ambiguous version" with quick actions: mark tenant as pinned to v1, open support contact, or opt into auto-fix. Ops should be able to apply a per-tenant header-precedence override.
kai: +1. also add a small canary rollout: default routing change behind a flag per-region, sample 1% traffic for 1h, if no regressions expand.
ian: code sketch for precedence (will submit PR):
```python
# router header precedence pseudo
if headers.get('x-client-version'):
    version = headers['x-client-version']
elif headers.get('x-version'):
    version = headers['x-version']
else:
    version = 'v2'  # current default fallback
```
maria: for billing, I'll add a guard: if handshake_source == 'client' and router later rewrites, keep original attribution until fixed. That requires plumbing handshake_source into usage events.
sarah: telemetry thresholds: fire an infra.warn if version_handshake_mismatch rate > 0.5% of a tenant's requests for 30m. Add dashboard panel under "Routing -> Version Signals" showing mismatch rate, top proxies rewriting headers, and quick links to logs.
devex-bot: suggested console lint text: "Ambiguous client version detected. This may cause routing to v2 and unexpected cost changes. Recommended: ensure SDK sends x-client-version and update proxies to preserve it."
ian: ops runbook (proposal): 1) check "Version Signals" panel 2) run header-preserve check on proxy 3) apply per-tenant pin if needed 4) flip canary flag for region
kai: I'll open an infra PR for header precedence + handshake_source telemetry, and a small console patch for the badge. maria, can you own billing guard?
maria: yep — I'll create the billing PR and sync with finance on non-retroactive attribution.
sarah: I'll wire up the dashboard and alert rules; will add the canary config options to the rollouts UX page.
ian: quick note: we should add an integration test that simulates proxies that rewrite headers so we don't regress this again.
kai: thanks team. tagging follow-ups: @maria will own billing guard, @ian router precedence PR, @sarah dashboard + alerts. I'll draft a short status update for SRE and Product.
maria: ack, will follow up with PR link in this thread.
ian: added a unit test locally, pushing in a small branch.
devex-bot: lint check queued for console patch (job 48233).
kai: nice. closing loop — will post PR numbers and canary start time once ready. :thumbsup:
